'''2007 Endor Regionals Mark Sebring DS Agents Of Black Sun''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Mark Sebring]] at [[2007 Endor Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince|Ref2-D-agentsofblacksun.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Agents of the Black Sun
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
